content.title: About
content.content: The Nutritional Powder Mix (NFS, item 5493) is a balanced blend of high‑quality proteins, vitamins, minerals and carbohydrates designed to support energy, muscle recovery and overall health. The powder dissolves easily in water, milk or juice and is suitable for athletes as well as active‑lifestyle individuals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend combines whey and plant proteins, providing a complete amino‑acid profile.
It includes adaptogens such as rhodiola extract to help the body cope with stress.
Each serving delivers more than 20 % of the daily reference intake for vitamin D and calcium.
The product is free from gluten, lactose and artificial sweeteners.
Packaging is made from recyclable material, reducing environmental impact.

items.title: Supports muscle growth
items.content: A rich protein complex promotes muscle‑protein synthesis and speeds up post‑workout recovery.

items.title: Boosts energy levels
items.content: A mix of fast‑ and slow‑digesting carbohydrates provides steady energy without sharp blood‑sugar spikes.

items.title: Enhances immune function
items.content: B‑vitamins, vitamin C and zinc support the immune system’s normal activity.

items.title: Promotes bone health
items.content: Calcium, vitamin D and magnesium help maintain bone density.

items.title: Reduces stress
items.content: Adaptogenic ingredients help lessen fatigue and improve adaptation to physical stress.

items.title: Protein allergy
items.content: The product contains whey protein, which may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with dairy‑protein intolerance.

items.title: Excessive protein intake
items.content: Very high consumption can place strain on the kidneys, especially in people with pre‑existing kidney conditions.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although moderate, people with diabetes should account for the carbohydrate amount in their total daily intake.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: High levels of vitamin K may affect the efficacy of anticoagulants; consult a healthcare professional if you take such medication.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one scoop (≈30 g) of powder with 250–300 ml of water, milk or a plant‑based beverage. For a thicker texture, add a banana or oats. Consumption is recommended immediately after training or as a nutritious snack between meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place, tightly sealed. After opening, use within 3 months and keep refrigerated if ambient temperature exceeds 25 °C.
